measurement_method: PowerShell polls process working sets every 500 ms with Get-Process while prepare_media1080.py runs and accumulates matching ffmpeg.exe working sets.
measurement_run: full 300-frame encode, four JPEG qualities, audio extraction and MJP packing
note: Per-process Python peak was below 150 MiB; combined Python plus FFmpeg working set was above 150 MiB. Working-set sampling is approximate and excludes other processes.
